topic: The Most Common Mistake Businesses Make With Their Website

slides.text: The most expensive website mistake we see every single week
slides.subtext: And most businesses have no idea they are making it.

slides.text: Building a website and never touching it again
slides.subtext: A website is not a brochure. It is a living tool. If it has not changed in 2 years, it is working against you.

slides.text: No clear call to action on the homepage
slides.subtext: Visitors land on your site and do not know what to do next. So they leave. Every second of confusion costs you a customer.

slides.text: Designing for themselves instead of their customers
slides.subtext: Your favourite colour and your logo size do not matter. What matters is whether the visitor can find what they need in 5 seconds.

slides.text: Ignoring mobile — even though 70% of visitors are on their phone
slides.subtext: If your site is hard to use on mobile, 7 out of 10 visitors will leave before reading a single word.

slides.text: No contact form, no phone number visible above the fold
slides.subtext: If someone is ready to buy and cannot find how to reach you, they will find your competitor instead.

slides.text: Tag a business owner who needs to read this today

caption:
The most expensive website mistake we see every single week — and most businesses have no idea they are making it.

Building a website and never touching it again. It is not a brochure. It is a living tool.

No clear call to action. Visitors land and do not know what to do next — so they leave.

Designing for themselves instead of their customers. Your favourite colour does not close deals.

Ignoring mobile — even though 70% of visitors are on their phone.

No contact form visible above the fold. If they cannot reach you in 5 seconds, they call your competitor.

Save this. Check your own site. Fix what you find.
